body:
For anyone struggling with this in the meantime, a workaround is to reference the window object outside the timeout, and use that reference in the function called by the timeout, e.g:

```javascript
let windowRef = window
setTimeout(() => {
  windowRef.location.replace('foo/bar.html')
})
```

I stumbled across this error today. i used `history.replaceState` as workaround

```javascript
history.replaceState(null,'', 'foo/bar.html');
```

Examples - This can be login with ajax and redirect to home page . - In SPA app add new item with ajax and redirect to detail page. or use any async redirection. Many SPA routers uses similar approach. ### Current behavior: When in app change hash location with delay (`setTimeout`) test will leave current page and go to parent page (cypress runner page). In my case `http://localhost:8080/__/#/some/route/1` - If set "chromeWebSecurity" to `true`, when run `cypress open` and select test get error `CypressError: Cypress detected a cross origin error happened on page load:...` - If set "chromeWebSecurity" to `false`, when run `cypress run` get error `Error: EISDIR: illegal operation on a directory, open 'C:\Users\fakeuser\AppData\Roaming\Cypress\cy\production\projects\cypress-playground-98c610aaf979570d4bd341aac2a02314\bundles'` ### Desired behavior: When in app change hash location with delay (`setTimeout`) test will stay on current page. In my case http://localhost:8080/index.html#/some/route/1 Do not want to see any error. ### Steps to reproduce: (app code and test code) Added failing test case in forked cypress-test-tiny https://github.com/njevdjo/cypress-test-tiny #### App code: ```html Cy issue
CLICK ME
``` #### Test code: ```js describe('cy issue hash with delay', () => { beforeEach(function () { cy.visit("index.html") }) it('change hash with delay', () => { cy.get('#my-link').contains('CLICK ME').click(); cy.wait(1000); cy.get('#my-link').contains('CLICK ME') }) }) ``` ### Versions Cypress package version: 3.6.1 Cypress binary version: 3.6.1 Operating System: Windows10 64bit Browser: Chrome 78 Electron: 73 (headless) Related to: #1244 #1681 #2367 #3077 #3697 #3994 #5376 #5629 #5717

body:
Workaround by change app code from
```js
setTimeout(() => window.location.href = "#/some/route/1", 500)
```
to
```js
setTimeout(() => window.location.hash = "#/some/route/1", 500)
```

issue.body:
<!-- Thanks for contributing!
Read our contribution guidelines here: 
https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md -->

- [x] Closes #5271 - replacing x.top, x.parent with dynamic interceptors
- [x] Closes #1467 - rewrite code to enforce x.top, x.parent correctness
- [x] Closes #2393 - SRI stripping
- [x] Closes #3975 - relative location.href setter does not work as expected
- [x] Closes #3994 - relative location.replace does not work as expected
- [x] Closes #2664 - x.frames reference incorrectly replaced

### User facing changelog

#### Experimental fixes

**To access these fixes, enable experimental source rewriting with the config value `experimentalSourceRewriting: true`:**

- Fixed issues where use of `window.top` and `window.parent` could cause the AUT to break out of the Cypress iframe. Fixes #5271 and #1467.
- Fixed an issue where `window.frames`, `window.parent.frames`, and other `frames` accesses could point to the wrong reference after being proxied through Cypress. Fixes #2664.
- Fixed an issue where scripts using the `integrity` attribute for sub-resource integrity (SRI) would not load after being proxied through Cypress. Fixes #2393.
- Fixed an issue where setting `location` or `location.href` to a relative href, or using `location.replace` or `location.assign` with a relative href, could result in the wrong URL being navigated to. Fixes #3975 and #3994.

### Additional details

- Adds AST-based rewriting behind experimental flag `experimentalSourceRewriting`: 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1151760/81345044-cba72380-9085-11ea-854e-51b25f46d456.png)
- [x] Explore serving source maps so users can still debug their original source code: https://github.com/benjamn/recast#source-maps
	- [x] ~~may possibly conflict with #6724 go-to-line functionality~~ error improvements only consume sourcemaps for specfiles, not AUT JS (yet) - ~~so we can get away with simply inlining sourcemaps for now~~
	- [x] sourcemaps will be served over HTTP, we don't want the overhead of generating them for every single JS loaded - unfortunately this requires some caching of JS
	- [x] also intercept SourceMap and X-SourceMap headers
		- order of preference: inlined sourcemappingurl, sourcemap header, x-sourcemap header
- [x] Strip script integrity parameters - fixes #2393 
	- SRI `integrity` attributes in `<script type="text/javascript">` tags will be rewritten to `cypress:stripped-integrity` attributes - `<script type="text/javascript" integrity="foo">` becomes `<script type="text/javascript" cypress:stripped-integrity="foo">`
- [x] Cache rewritten code by ETags and potentially with a hash so it only needs 1 rewrite per session
	- HTTP caching semantics are hard, and existing cache mechanisms will still work inside a single browser session, so this can be implemented later
- [x] Fix SIGSEGV when exiting with threads active: https://github.com/electron/electron/issues/23366
	- fixed with an ugly hack on intercepting process.exit, :cry: 
- [x] Throw error in driver if AST rewriting fails, since this is a bug in Cypress.

Note: This PR is huge because it does not replace the regex-based rewriting (yet), so there are some duplicate code paths and tests.

#### Checklist before removing "experimental" status: https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/issues/7297

### How has the user experience changed?

More user sites will work OOTB with Cypress :tada:
